purpose: Truthful per-product-line implementation baseline. The two state fields are independent: code_implemented says an executable path exists with focused tests; scenario_validated says a permissioned real-world scenario ran the declared acceptance set with recorded evidence and independent review. A product may be code_implemented and still scenario_validated=false.

field_definitions.code_implemented: Executable code path exists in this repository (or the named owning repository) and focused automated tests cover its declared behavior.
field_definitions.scenario_validated: A permissioned real scenario was executed end-to-end and passed the predeclared acceptance set, with recorded evidence (bundles/fingerprints/commit SHAs) and independent review.
field_definitions.not_implemented: No executable implementation is verified; only documents or plans exist.

release_rule: code_implemented=true MUST NOT be read as scenario_validated. Unit tests do not validate a scenario. Missing or unsupported evidence is inconclusive, never pass.

mission_baseline_reconciliation.reason: The mission brief asserted code_implemented=false for AE/BE on the premise that this repository is an empty skeleton. That premise is falsified by the repository itself: 188 commits, 10 merge PRs (#3, #10-#18) and executable modules tensorbench/achievement.py, live_mission.py, evidence_bundle.py, business_evidence.py, pdf_evidence.py with focused tests, all present before this mission started. Recording code_implemented=false for AE/BE would be a fabricated baseline. The scenario_validated field is false for all four lines exactly as asserted, and RA/PV remain false because their implementations live in TensorKnowledge/TensorData and are not verified here.
